def unique_in_order(items):
    """Remove duplicate strings while preserving their first occurrence.

    >>> unique_in_order(['Will', 'Rafal', 'Will', 'David'])
    ['Will', 'Rafal', 'David']
    >>> unique_in_order([])
    []
    """
expected:
seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result
